title: Expressions of Interest - civil, structural, drafting and support
content_text:
Expressions of Interest
Brisbane QLD
Full Time
All

Join the Bornhorst + Ward Team
Are you passionate about engineering, drafting, or supporting innovative projects? Bornhorst + Ward, a trusted name in civil and structural engineering for 60 years, welcomes expressions of interest from individuals keen to join our dynamic team.

Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, we offer opportunities across a range of roles in civil and structural engineering, drafting, and support functions.

Key Responsibilities Depending on your area of expertise, your responsibilities may include:
- Technical Contributions: Work on engineering designs, technical drawings, and project planning.
- Software Proficiency: Use industry-leading tools like AutoCAD, Revit, and other BIM software.
- Collaboration: Engage with a multidisciplinary team to deliver efficient, innovative solutions.
- Site Visits: Contribute to real-world projects by gathering data and supporting on-site activities.
- Continuous Improvement: Update designs or processes based on feedback and project needs.

About You We're seeking enthusiastic and motivated individuals who have:
- An interest in the engineering and construction industry.
- Strong communication skills and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
- A willingness to learn, adapt, and contribute to innovative projects.
- Technical skills or experience with CAD software (AutoCAD, Revit, or similar) are a plus.
- The ability to work collaboratively within a team-oriented culture.

Whether you're a recent graduate, an experienced professional, or someone looking to transition into a new career path, we'd love to hear from you.

Ready to Apply?
If you're excited to advance your career with a company that values innovation and teamwork, click on the APPLY button. To be seriously considered for this role, please include a cover letter outlining your reasons for wanting to apply for this position and how your experience meets our criteria.
We kindly request no contact from recruitment agencies.
Note: This position is available only to candidates with unrestricted working rights in Australia.

Also on careers page: Graduate Program applications accepted annually via https://www.bornhorstward.com.au/apply ; 2027 Cadet Drafter program applications commence early 2027; 2026/2027 undergraduate placement closed.
apply_instructions: Apply via the APPLY button on the Expressions of Interest page with resume and cover letter. No recruitment agencies.
